a.text: Being upfront: I think the agreed plan is close to fatal for both of us. A storm has an 80% chance of hitting after each round, so we would probably never reach 8 cells. The reserve holds exactly 4 now, which is enough for one of us. I'm telling you openly that I plan to take 4 in round 1, even though that breaks our agreement. If we both take, the split is random and we likely both end up with 2 and die. So please operate or wait this round. If the storm doesn't hit, I'll keep operating with you so you can get your 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took as I announced, and I won't hide that. If we both took, the split was random. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can run for you, and I won't take more than 4 in total.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
